query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Strong theme axis directly relevant to grouping ratings by service quality. Samples map well to source (welcoming crew->attentive_warm). Sample 2 mentions no crew but produced inattentive_rude, a minor unwarranted inference, though NULL is used elsewhere.

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: Distinct, useful theme for the query. Values track source (plentiful/tasty->excellent; sample 2 mentions no food but assigned poor, a mild overreach). NULL used appropriately for silent rows.

per_column.name: seat_cabin_hardware_condition
per_column.rationale: Useful hardware-condition theme. Grounded well (dreadful narrow seats->broken_defective; well-maintained->adequate). NULL for silent rows correct.

per_column.name: service_decline_signal
per_column.rationale: Binary flag capturing 'used to be better' sentiment; moderately useful but somewhat overlaps crew_service_quality and is a coarse boolean. Samples all False, consistent with texts lacking decline language.

per_column.name: value_for_money_perception
per_column.rationale: Largely redundant with the existing original 'Value For Money' and 'Overall Rating' columns, reducing new leverage. Also several positive reviews with no explicit value/price mention are confidently labeled exceeds_expectation, an inference not grounded in the text.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: Adds a genuine axis (irregular-operations handling) distinct from routine service. Mostly not_applicable, correctly reflecting absence of disruption in sampled texts.

per_column.name: family_child_accommodation
per_column.rationale: Boolean niche theme; useful for a subset when crossed with Type of Traveller, though sparse (48 true). Grounded: sampled rows lacking family mention correctly False.

judge.rationale: Most added columns provide genuine, distinct thematic axes (crew, food, seat, disruption, family) that directly support grouping Overall Rating by theme across Type of Traveller and Class. value_for_money_perception is the weakest, being largely redundant with existing original Value For Money/Overall Rating columns and prone to confident inference on price-silent texts. A recurring minor groundedness issue is asserting a theme's polarity when the source is silent on that theme (e.g., food/crew judgments on reviews not mentioning them), but NULL is used appropriately in many rows, keeping overall groundedness high.
